summary: BUUU Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 25, 2026, disclosing that majority-owned subsidiary Brightray Science Inc., through Brightray Veridian Pte. Ltd., entered a non-binding Prefabricated Module Sales Framework Agreement with a Macao customer developing a planned 40MW AI data center in Coloane. No price, stake, or closing terms are stated; pricing is provisional. Delivery is targeted for Q3 2027, and the agreement auto-terminates September 30, 2027 absent a binding tenant lease. This is an ordinary commercial contract, not a special situation.
